author: Codex /root/review_events_harness

verification.source_hashes: All41 named-case source hashes and function-body hashes independently recomputed with C string/comment-aware brace extraction; all matched.
verification.registration: Every case is invoked by the appropriate C/API, GC/API or IO/API main; consumer/stdout routing matches check-core-image.ps1.
verification.witnesses: All40 exact witnesses are actual terminal puts calls within their named function. The remaining cold-constructor witness is the terminal measured-count printf.
verification.links: All77 entries resolve to the same complete source#case identity sets in the reviewed API mapping; no missing case identities or fabricated stdout strings.

cold_sweep_review.reason: Baseline measures actual growth count and asserts it positive. Every position1..growths is refused persistently in a fresh state, requiring null constructor result and zero bytes/blocks. A growths+1 recovery run must succeed and release everything before the terminal measured-count print.
cold_sweep_review.pattern: Positive integer count is appropriate; no fixed platform value should be required. Independently checked proposed regex accepts37 and rejects0 and trailing junk. Match exact lines and require exactly one occurrence.
cold_sweep_review.boundary: This witness certifies the named measured sweep when actual execution provenance and full process checks hold; it does not imply identical C/Ada object layouts or growth counts.

capture_driver_review: Driver captures both streams before waiting; timeout/nonzero exit/nonempty stderr/missing final consumer marker reject the run.

Each consumer record now contains executable and stdout/stderr SHA256, exact profile/library/configuration and timeout/exit status. Final report binds repository revision/dirty state, runtime libraries and consumer sources.

GC and IO real-library contracts execute separately against the pinned C oracle and compare captured output byte-for-byte. Ordinary c-api consumer is Ada execution; no nonexistent full C-oracle consumer pass is asserted.
Consumer GPR retains assert-enabled C compilation; no NDEBUG switch is present. Named-case witness checking must remain in addition to the existing process-level marker, not replaced by it.
limitations: This is source/semantic mapping review only. No new consumer process or build was executed by this reviewer.
Actual final-revision result.json/capture hashes and exact context/configuration still must be inspected before runtime promotion.
The witness proposal does not itself implement exact-count matching; acceptance code must enforce its stated requirements and reject missing, duplicate or mismatched captures.
Supporting cases stay supporting; union of markers cannot expand reviewed API semantics, especially collector parameter scheduling and full ABI boundaries.

capture_metadata_delta_review.author: Codex /root
rationale: Platform identity is derived from the actual host for the supported Windows/macOS/Linux contexts; reference revision is read from the pinned reference checkout and command failure throws.
Repository revision and dirty state are captured before the campaign; dirty runs are explicitly diagnostic-only. Consumer source hashes and executable/library identities remain recorded.
stdout/stderr path and SHA256 are computed from the just-written capture files, alongside exit code, timeout, profile, library type and configuration.
Original named-case bodies, proposal mappings and process success/failure checks are unchanged.
limitations: Metadata availability alone is not acceptance; final ingestion must verify clean expected revision, pinned reference, context and capture/source hashes.
This review runs no build or consumer and establishes no runtime pass.

consuming_driver_delta.review: Campaigns supply the selected runtime to the C consumer and image consumer. Owner builds explicitly disable externally built mode. The consumer driver hashes the selected input, requires both GPR imports to use the prebuilt library and compares its bytes after linking and after execution. The named C witnesses and output checks retain their behavior. Runtime identity requires fresh matching job artifacts.
